about_the_game:
Welcome to the town of Red Iron. While small and unassuming at first glance, it has been home to several mysteries over the years. Most people don't want to bother with poking their noses into the strange happenings, but there are some exceptions.

Enter Andrew Connor, whose entire life changed one fateful night in 1995, but he has a hard time remembering why. With his life upside down, he looks to the past with hopes of putting it to rest, permanently.

Follow the echoes, uncover hidden truths, and remember to make it out alive.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Phenom II
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 400 series / AMD Radeon HD 7000 series
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 44,100 Hz playback device
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL 3.3 (GPU) and SSE2 (CPU) support required
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04+
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Intel Core i5-3570 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 680 / AMD Radeon R9 280X
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 44,100 Hz playback device
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL 3.3 (GPU) and SSE2 (CPU) support required

short_description: Enter a small town filled with mysteries to help Andrew Connor solve one of his own. Work your way through the past and help put it, and the people involved, to rest for good. Just remember to be careful, danger could be hidden around any corner.
